That catalogue mix is the AppDynamics implementation filter — not a generic it-development lecture.

Buyer question: does paid tier gating incident management change the AppDynamics decision before seats scale?

Decision thesis: unlike a generic it-development shortlist, AppDynamics is worth it if Cisco-aligned estates that will model vCPU Premium list price (not list price infra-only) as APM TCO outweighs Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) — trade-off accepted before seats scale.

Best for: Cisco-aligned estates that will model vCPU Premium list price (not list price infra-only) as APM TCO; APM buyers comparing AppDynamics to Dynatrace DPS and Datadog modules; Teams already in a Cisco EA who will not self-serve Datadog tiles (Cisco-aligned estates that will model vCPU Premium list price (not list price infra-only) as APM TCO).

Poor fit when: SMBs that need Datadog’s published list price/host Infrastructure Pro tile; High-cardinality event specialists (Honeycomb); ITSM or on-call-only purchases. Avoid if Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) would block go-live.

sections.heading: AppDynamics limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); list price/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium list price is; Cisco EA quotes often replace public vCPU tiles because it forces process changes or add-ons around AppDynamics when incident management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on paid tier with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain incident management at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot.

Alternative context: unlike Datadog, AppDynamics is preferable when Cisco-aligned estates that will model vCPU Premium list price (not list price infra-only) as APM TCO because incident management plus incident management match; prefer Datadog when SMBs that need Datadog’s published list price/host Infrastructure Pro tile because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for AppDynamics
sections.body:
Scenario: for incident management teams, recommend AppDynamics when Cisco-aligned estates that will model vCPU Premium list price (not list price infra-only) as APM TCO; recommend an alternative path when SMBs that need Datadog’s published list price/host Infrastructure Pro tile because Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for incident management plus a freeze window if Aws are in the cutover path.

Integrations in research: Aws, Azure, Slack.

Final call: proceed with AppDynamics when incident management plus incident management outweigh Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); walk when SMBs that need Datadog’s published list price/host Infrastructure Pro tile because workarounds will eat the paid tier spend.
